entities.name: Smart Fire Hydrant
entities.rationale: Drawn illustration of a fire hydrant representing the smart IoT sensor devices collecting acoustic pipe network data.

entities.name: API GATEWAY
entities.rationale: AWS API Gateway icon labeled 'API GATEWAY', used as the secure entry point for IoT file ingestion.

entities.name: S3
entities.rationale: AWS S3 icon labeled 'S3', used to store and persist the ingested acoustic files.

entities.name: ECS
entities.rationale: AWS ECS icon labeled 'ECS', running containerized microservices to process files in batch and identify acoustic correlations.

entities.name: SAGEMAKER
entities.rationale: AWS SageMaker icon labeled 'SAGEMAKER', hosting ML models to score and assign leak probabilities to persistent correlations.

entities.name: ANALYST
entities.rationale: Human actor icon labeled 'ANALYST', representing the human analysis team that reviews leak scores and coordinates field investigations.

visual_connections.description: Green curved arrow indicating acoustic data files are pushed from the fire hydrants to API Gateway.
Green curved arrow showing API Gateway sending and persisting incoming files into Amazon S3.
Green curved arrow showing batch microservice jobs in ECS reading and processing stored files from S3.
Green curved arrow showing persistent correlation results sent from ECS to SageMaker for classification.
